description: The sidebar outline on article pages now opens on tap for pocket-size screens while the wide-screen sidebar stays exactly as readers know it, with no scripts and no new palette.
lead: Long reads open with an outline of their sections. On a wide screen that outline sits pinned beside the prose; on a phone it now starts closed under a labelled row and opens with one tap, so the headline and the opening lines own the first view.
